title: purge_after is stamped only by the submit terminal; refused/objected terminals never get one despite the column contract 'stamped at terminal'
evidence:
supabase/migrations/20260731222000_create_reference_call.sql:128: "purge_after     TIMESTAMPTZ,                         -- stamped at terminal: follows the application's retention schedule"
:151: "ON reference_call(purge_after) WHERE purge_after IS NOT NULL;"
server/src/reference_checks/sql/terminalize_reference_call.sql:18-24: "UPDATE reference_call
SET status          = $2::reference_call_status,
    outcome         = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, '')::reference_call_outcome, outcome),
    terminal_reason = COALESCE(NULLIF($4, ''), terminal_reason),
    result          = $5::jsonb,
    next_attempt_at = NULL,
    updated_at      = now()"
detail: Only complete_reference_call.sql stamps purge_after (submit path). Declined (refused) and objected rows keep purge_after NULL, so the partial index idx_reference_call_purge structurally excludes them from any future rc3-x purge sweep; their referee PII then relies solely on application CASCADE. No sweep exists today, so impact is deferred.
recommended_fix: Stamp purge_after in terminalize_reference_call too (join to application.retention_due_at, or pass it as a parameter like complete_reference_call does) so every terminal row carries its purge date.

title: Exit handlers omit handle_resend's injectable seam and the new notify_reference_* path has zero test pins; dispatch errors are discarded
evidence:
server/src/reference_checks/form_handler.gleam:571: "pub type ResendSend =" / :579: "pub fn resend_with_send(" (the template seam)
:1310: "let _ = case event {" and :1312: "notification_dispatch.notify_reference_completed("
server/test/integration/reference_exit_routes_integration_test.gleam: "string.contains(simulate.read_body(response), "reference-thank-you") |> should.be_true" and "objection_log_count(db, row_id) |> should.equal(1)" — the suite asserts body/DB state only; grep for notify/reference_completed/reference_declined/reference_objected in server/test and shared/test returns zero hits.
detail: The spec's pattern-fidelity block names the injectable seam as part of the template; the exit handlers drop it and bind to notification_dispatch directly. Because notify_reference_event discards the Result, a broken dispatch (wrong enum string, no-rows insert) passes CI silently — dispatch() only log_warnings on DB errors. Spec task 8's 'notification dispatch per preference' test is absent.
recommended_fix: Assert notification rows (title/body/type/entity) in the exit-route integration tests after each terminal POST, or add a @internal dispatch seam so the notifier is unit-testable; log the discarded Result on Error.

title: ObjectionChannel shared enum lacks the 'web' variant the new migration adds to the DB CHECK
evidence:
supabase/migrations/20260810190315_reference_objection_log_channel_web.sql:17: "    CHECK (channel IN ('form','sms','email','web'));"
shared/src/shared/reference_call.gleam:85-89: "pub type ObjectionChannel {
  ObjectionForm
  ObjectionSms
  ObjectionEmail
}"
server/src/reference_checks/form_handler.gleam:1023: "                "web"," (raw string passed to apply_objection, bypassing the enum)
detail: The PR widens the constraint but not the mirror enum, so the shared type and the DB now disagree. Inert today because the single writer passes the raw string, but the future inbound-email second writer and the existing encode_objection_channel codecs cannot represent 'web' — the drift the minion documented as a future story.
recommended_fix: Add ObjectionWeb to ObjectionChannel (encode 'web') in this PR while the CHECK change is in flight, or schedule it with the inbound-email writer so the codec never round-trips a value the enum cannot name.
